title: BostonApartments.com Mobile App
description: A cross-platform mobile experience dedicated to helping tenants find properties all across Massachusetts.
problem: Customers who utilize bostonapartments.com do not have a convienient way of taking the websites utility with them. There was also need for mobile presence in order to stand strong against competitors.
solution: In using React/React Native libraries, a mobile experience was created that puled apartment and property listings from a remote database. Every User is able to input their preferences and the app will provide custom listings for them everyday.
lessons_learned: Experience with integrating legacy servers. API endpoint creation. Actively working through a disciplined SCRUM process to meet sponsor requirements.

title: Portfolio Project Manager
description: A command-line interface application that accepts user input and exports persistent data to the desired project directory. Focuses on database management and data integrity.
problem: I needed to be able to easily update my website without having to modify the project's code directly.
solution: I developed an external python tool that collects and stores my project data. I can seamlessly transport that data to my portfolio site and utilize remote databases.
lessons_learned: Database structuring. Input validation. Python data manipulation.
